clue.text: Plants, variety found in shady ground

indicators.note: something found in another sits inside it, so the variety word goes into the middle of the jumbled letters
ground means crushed and broken up, so the letters of shady are reworked

parts.note: a range is a variety or assortment, as in a range of goods

explanation.surface: A gardener notes that one kind of plant thrives in a shaded spot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'variety' looks like part of the definition ('Plants, variety') but supplies the inserted letters; 'ground' is the anagram signal, not soil, giving HYDAS.
explanation.definitionFit: Hydrangeas are flowering shrubs, so they are an example of plants.

clue.text: Cope with mediocre journalist

definitions.meaning: to ... something is to manage or cope with it, as in 'can't ... it'
a writer, especially a journalist, who turns out dull, run-of-the-mill copy

explanation.surface: An editor puts up with a second-rate reporter.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses are everyday informal uses: managing to endure something, and a jobbing, uninspired writer.

clue.text: Sad seeing unemployment benefit maximum cut

parts.note: the dole is British slang for state unemployment benefit

indicators.note: cut here means docked of its final letter, as a word cut short

parts.note: full means at maximum capacity, as in full speed

explanation.surface: Someone is gloomy on learning their jobless payments have been capped.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cut' takes the last L off FULL, leaving FUL. The dole is the British name for unemployment benefit.
explanation.definitionFit: Doleful means mournful or sorrowful, a straightforward synonym for sad.

clue.text: Attack method that's used to train soldiers

parts.note: an assault is a violent attack
a course, as in a course of action, is a way or method of proceeding

explanation.surface: An instructor describes a fighting technique taught to army recruits.
explanation.definitionFit: An assault course is an obstacle course on which military recruits are trained for fitness and agility.

clue.text: Fun manifestly absent every so often after golf

indicators.note: the rest of the wordplay comes after the golf letter

parts.note: G is golf in the NATO phonetic alphabet

indicators.note: letters are absent at regular intervals, so every other letter of manifestly is dropped

explanation.surface: Pleasure is plainly missing from occasional rounds of golf.
explanation.walkthrough: 'absent every so often' drops the odd letters of MANIFESTLY, leaving AIETY.
explanation.definitionFit: Gaiety is merriment or light-hearted enjoyment, which is what fun means.

clue.text: Type of soup, bat, a help prepared

indicators.note: prepared means made ready or put together, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A recipe list: a soup, a bat and some help, all made ready.
explanation.walkthrough: 'prepared' reworks all eight letters of 'bat, a help'; 'Type of soup' is the definition, alphabet soup.
explanation.definitionFit: Alphabet soup is a broth with pasta shaped like letters, so the word names a kind of soup.

clue.text: Inclination to show prejudice?

definitions.meaning: a leaning or tendency one way
to influence unfairly, to make or be prejudiced

explanation.surface: Is a tendency the same thing as being bigoted?
explanation.definitionFit: The noun is a leaning or slant; the verb means to skew judgement unfairly.

clue.text: Enormous lie Emma sensed getting repeatedly exposed

indicators.note: exposed means stripped of covering, so each word in turn loses its outer letters

explanation.surface: Emma catches a whopping falsehood being found out again and again.
explanation.walkthrough: 'getting repeatedly exposed' strips the first and last letters from each of LIE, EMMA and SENSED, leaving I, MM and ENSE.
explanation.definitionFit: Immense means extremely large or vast, a direct synonym for enormous.

clue.text: Enjoyable day is fast-moving, meal ultimately is skipped

parts.note: Sat is the short form of Saturday

indicators.note: a skipped letter is left out of the word

parts.note: flying means moving very quickly, as in a flying start

indicators.note: ultimately means at the end, so the last letter of meal is taken

explanation.surface: A pleasant, busy day when lunch gets missed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ultimately' gives L, the end of MEAL, and 'is skipped' takes that L out of FLYING, leaving FYING.
explanation.definitionFit: Something satisfying gives contentment and pleasure, so it is enjoyable.

clue.text: Deficit stops firm investing at first huge figures

indicators.note: something that stops a gap plugs it, so this word is set inside the others

parts.note: Co is the abbreviation for company, a firm

indicators.note: at first means the opening letter of investing is used

parts.note: a loss is a deficit, money down

explanation.surface: A shortfall halts a company's investment plans.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stops' works like a stopper in a bottle: the deficit plugs the gap in the firm plus I.
explanation.definitionFit: Colossi are gigantic statues, such as the Colossus of Rhodes, so enormous figures.

clue.text: Drop choice to lead London's police force

indicators.note: to lead means to come in front, so this piece goes first

parts.note: plum means choice or highly desirable, as in a plum job
the Met is the Metropolitan Police, which polices London

explanation.surface: A selection is made to head the capital's police service.
explanation.walkthrough: The Met is the everyday name for the Metropolitan Police, London's force.
explanation.definitionFit: To plummet is to fall steeply, so it means drop as a verb.

clue.text: Outside hospital Helen's aunt is developing dangerous condition

indicators.note: outside means the jumbled letters sit around the hospital letter
developing means changing form, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: H is the abbreviation for hospital, as on road signs

explanation.surface: Helen's aunt falls ill and gets worse while waiting outside a hospital.
explanation.walkthrough: 'developing' rearranges HELENSAUNTIS into UNEALTHINESS, which goes 'Outside' H.
explanation.definitionFit: Unhealthiness is a state of poor health, which can be a hazardous condition.

clue.text: Female condemned rich uni mates, they're often in casinos

indicators.note: condemned means sentenced or ruined, so the letters are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: A woman denounces wealthy university friends who spend their time gambling.
explanation.walkthrough: A fruit machine is the British name for a slot machine, after the fruit symbols on its reels.
explanation.definitionFit: Fruit machines are slot machines, gambling devices commonly found in casinos and arcades.

clue.text: Elderly claiming German that's regularly avoided tax caused annoyance

indicators.note: claiming means taking hold of, so the elderly word wraps round the rest

parts.note: aged means old or elderly

indicators.note: letters avoided at regular intervals means every other letter of German is dropped

parts.note: VAT is value added tax

explanation.surface: An old person grumbles about a German who keeps dodging his taxes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'regularly avoided' keeps the 1st, 3rd and 5th letters of the six; 'that's' is a link. Aggravated in the annoyed sense is informal.
explanation.definitionFit: Aggravated in informal use means annoyed or irritated, so it is a past-tense verb for caused irritation.

clue.text: Ice cream retired teetotal Egyptian is eating

indicators.note: retired means withdrawn or gone back, so the letters are read backwards
a word eating letters holds them inside, so the answer is concealed in these words

explanation.surface: A frozen dessert being consumed by a non-drinking Egyptian who has stopped working.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is eating' finds OTALEG inside 'teetotal Egyptian'; 'retired' turns it backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Gelato is the Italian style of ice cream, denser and softer than most.

clue.text: Crossing Spain lady set off in unhurried manner

indicators.note: crossing means stretching across, so the jumbled letters straddle the Spain letter
off means gone wrong or out of order, so the letters are shuffled

parts.note: E is the international vehicle registration code for Spain

explanation.surface: A woman sets out across Spain at a leisurely pace.
explanation.walkthrough: 'off' gives SDATELY from the shuffled pair, and 'Crossing' means it straddles E, the international vehicle code for Spain.
explanation.definitionFit: Sedately means in a calm, unhurried way, so it matches the adverbial phrase.

clue.text: One whose work may provide a little relief?

definitions.text: One whose work may provide a little relief?

parts.words: One whose work may provide a little relief
parts.note: relief also means a carving raised from a flat background, so the artist meant is one who carves

explanation.surface: Someone whose job eases a bit of stress or pain.
explanation.walkthrough: Relief here is not comfort but relief carving, figures raised from a flat surface.
explanation.definitionFit: This artist carves or models figures, and low-relief panels are one kind of that work.

clue.text: Censure for breaking hand

indicators.note: breaking means splitting open, so the second word goes inside the first

parts.note: to reach can mean to hand or pass something to someone
pro means for, in favour of

explanation.surface: Someone is told off for fracturing their hand.
explanation.walkthrough: 'hand' is a verb here: to reach someone something is to hand it over. 'breaking' signals the insertion.
explanation.definitionFit: To reproach is to criticise or express disapproval, which is what censure means.

clue.text: Write article on church as form of atonement

indicators.note: on here means placed next to, joining the pieces

parts.note: to pen is to write
an is the indefinite article
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: Writing an essay about the church is done to make amends.
explanation.definitionFit: Penance is an act of self-punishment or devotion done to make amends for wrongdoing.

clue.text: Injury worry

definitions.meaning: stress or anxiety, a source of worry

explanation.surface: An injury causes concern.
explanation.definitionFit: Both are common senses: a pulled muscle, and mental pressure or tension.

clue.text: Island occupant I guarantee to protect

indicators.note: words that protect something hold it safe inside them, so the answer is concealed here

explanation.surface: A tenant promises to defend an island.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to protect' signals letters held within 'occupANT I GUArantee'.
explanation.definitionFit: Antigua is a Caribbean island, part of the nation of Antigua and Barbuda.

clue.text: Conservative, forty-nine maybe?

definitions.meaning: 49 is seven times seven; the question mark marks it as one example

explanation.surface: A Tory aged about fifty?
explanation.definitionFit: Square is slang for staid and conventional, and also a number that is an integer multiplied by itself.

clue.text: Refusing single answer, trivial question unsettled entertainer

indicators.note: unsettled means disturbed, so the remaining letters are rearranged
refusing means turning away, so these letters are left out of the pool

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one, single

explanation.surface: A performer who won't give a one-word reply is rattled by a silly quiz question.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Refusing' removes I and A from TRIVIALQUESTION; 'unsettled' rearranges the remaining thirteen letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A ventriloquist is a stage performer who throws their voice through a dummy.

clue.text: King, tense over guards on journey

indicators.note: guards means surrounds to protect, so the reversed pair goes around the other piece
over means turned over, so these two letters are read backwards

parts.note: K is the chess abbreviation for king
T is the grammatical abbreviation for tense
re means on or concerning, as in a letter heading

explanation.surface: A tense king keeps watch over his guards on an expedition.
explanation.walkthrough: 'over' turns KT into TK, and 'guards' puts RE (on, about) between them.
explanation.definitionFit: A trek is a long, arduous trip, so it is a kind of journey.

clue.text: Circle Line information that finally worker absorbs

indicators.note: finally means the closing letter of that is taken
absorbs means takes in, so the worker wraps round the information

parts.note: the ant is the crossword's stock worker insect
gen is British slang for information

explanation.surface: Details about a Tube route soaked up by a member of staff.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Circle Line' looks like the London Underground route; read it as a line touching a circle. Gen is British slang for information.
explanation.definitionFit: In geometry a tangent is a straight line that touches a curve such as a circle at one point.

clue.text: Rage consumes extremely vindictive person seeking retribution

indicators.note: consumes means swallows, so the rage word holds the other letters

parts.note: anger is rage

indicators.note: extremely means at the extremities, so the first and last letters of vindictive are taken

explanation.walkthrough: 'extremely' takes just the two outer letters of 'vindictive', which looks like part of the definition but is only fodder; 'consumes' signals the insertion.
explanation.definitionFit: An avenger is someone who takes revenge on behalf of a wrong, a seeker of retribution.

clue.text: Fight expected against school's closure

indicators.note: against means next to, so the pieces sit side by side

parts.note: due means expected, as in the train is due

indicators.note: closure means the end, so the last letter of school's is taken

explanation.surface: A battle is anticipated over plans to shut a school.
explanation.walkthrough: 'closure' gives L, the last letter of SCHOOL'S (ignoring the apostrophe).
explanation.definitionFit: A duel is a formal fight between two people, so a kind of fight.

clue.text: Wading bird environmentalists catch

parts.note: the Greens are environmentalists, members of Green parties
a hank is a ring or clip that catches a sail to a stay

explanation.surface: A long-legged bird is snared by eco-campaigners.
